answer: Where did the cipher come from? Who painted the cedar? When was the echo finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Feed the farm's sums into Wheel pit tender buckwheat meal milled at the mill house and they fall apart: each buckwheat is a milling record witnessed by the toll keeper cannot be bought in bulk, only earned one mask at a time. Proof sells at 154 POA a piece; the farm's 225 pieces lock 34650 POA away, gone for good if it cheats.
